about: packages/lbi/src/props.json: the lbi story's part of the catalogue of 3D sets (props; docs/props.md, tools/packages/SPEC.md "Miniatures"): what the design room's card of each of its miniatures shows; code is authoritative

sets.shows: A big glowing human protein interaction network (about 9,100 proteins, 22,100 interactions) with a dense centre and filaments towards the rim. The story lights curated pathways, the ATP synthase complex, flattens it into a city map with pins and a route, shows disease modules, a rare disease and its drug target, 173 immunity genes in 19 clusters, drug capsules and heat spreading from three seeds.
sets.frame: Centred on the origin, y up, about radius 1 (city mode flattens it onto a disc of radius 1.12). Views are [az, el, dist, tx, ty, tz].

data.text: Curated core = the 254 proteins and 375 interactions of the network-medicine story (curated). ATP synthase (13 subunits, 21 contacts) and the 19 immunity clusters come from shared facts. Background network, disease modules (after Menche et al. 2015), the rare disease and the patient seeds and heat are synthetic and illustrative.

sets.notes: Built at load from embedded data (about 0.2 to 0.6 s). 9.7k points, 22.1k line segments, 5 to 14 draw calls. int_path0..9 are ten curated-module highlights. Several views are getters that change when int_flat > 0.5. Extra exports select(), route(), pick(), partners(), info feed the tour's Proteins tab.

sets.shows: A beige 1990s all-in-one computer (no brand marks) on a table. It switches off like a CRT, comes apart in the order of a real teardown, every part lands in neat rows, glowing wires connect the chips, then the parts shrink into a network of 106 nodes and 209 links that lifts off the table.
sets.frame: y up; table top at y = -0.30; computer faces +z, keyboard in front, mouse right; network floats at (0, -0.14, 0).
sets.size: table 1.76 x 1.48 (corners reach radius ~1.15); network radius ~0.6

params.name: mac_a
params.meaning: the set's fade, 0 hidden to 1 shown (applied by the engine through setAlpha; a set never applies it itself)

params.name: mac_explode
params.meaning: 0: the assembled computer. 1: everything laid out on the table

params.name: mac_wire
params.meaning: The schematic wiring grows wire by wire. It only draws over the laid-out parts, so it is multiplied by prog(mac_explode, 0.75, 1) (unless the network has already lifted)

params.name: mac_net
params.meaning: parts shrink into glowing nodes (chips amber, resistors cyan, capacitors magenta, crystals green), wires straighten and the graph (106 nodes, 209 links) lifts off the table

data.text: Airport city positions are real (the airports story's 3,214 airports). The internet network, the 18,800 fainter lights and all friendship ties are illustrative.

sets.notes: Build 110 to 300 ms. Internet alone 2 draw calls, 15.9k points; globe alone 4 draw calls, 25k points, 32k segments. The hidden look is switched off. web_net and web_globe are meant to cross-fade; web_ties then web_spin run on the globe.

sets.shows: A long DNA double helix is written from the middle outwards, coils into the 23 chromosomes, threads grow from genes and fold into 25 AlphaFold-style protein chains in a 5 x 5 grid, which then becomes a tiny framed patch in a field of 20,000 proteins.

data.text: B-DNA geometry and GRCh38 chromosome lengths are real; the base sequence is random; the protein folds are stylised AlphaFold-like cartoons (colours from pLDDT bins) and the field is illustrative.

sets.notes: Params build on each other (keep earlier ones at 1 while a later one rises). A tunnel in the field is kept clear so the grid stays visible. Points fade within ~4 units of the eye (comfortable in a headset). Extra exports proteins, counts.

sets.shows: ATP synthase in three looks: a grid of its 13 AlphaFold-like chains, the assembled complex in a lipid membrane (protons turn the rotor, ATP pops out of the head), and the 13 parts and their 21 contacts as a network over a faint ghost of the complex.
sets.frame: Rotor axis on y; head at the top (matrix side), membrane at y ~ -0.38; subunit a and the peripheral stalk on +x. The parts grid lies in the z = 0 plane (x +-1.0, y +-0.9).

params.name: atp_a
params.meaning: the set's fade, 0 hidden to 1 shown (applied by the engine through setAlpha; a set never applies it itself)

params.name: atp_parts
params.meaning: The 13 chains draw themselves along their length, one after another, then float gently in the grid

params.name: atp_colour
params.meaning: Grey-teal (slide 13) changes to the group colours of slide 14: α, β, γ, δ, ε teal

params.name: atp_build
params.meaning: assembly: the 13 chains fly from the grid to their slots, copies split (alpha x3, beta x3, c x8), each grows into its sphere surface, helpers drift away, the membrane fades in

params.name: atp_turns
params.meaning: Rotor angle in turns, unbounded. The c-ring and the central stalk turn; the head and the peripheral stalk stay still

params.name: atp_flow
params.meaning: protons flow in through subunit a and ATP pops out of the head (meaningful once built)

params.name: atp_net
params.meaning: Network view (slide 15). The surface fades to a faint ghost (with a depth pre-pass, so only the outer skin shows) and the membrane dims

params.name: atp_shrink
params.meaning: The ghost fades out first (0 to 0.12), then the network shrinks into one bright point at the set's origin and fades; the membrane goes by 0.45

sets.shows: A standing figure, arms raised and hands crossed over the head, as a total-body PET maximum-intensity projection (about 52k glowing points, max blending, hot-iron colours). Twelve organ nodes rise onto a cage around the body, joined by bands that rewire between a healthy and a disease network, and a tracer injection can run.
